messages:
alex: Heads up — nightly integ is red. Failing against Hosted API when running streaming + toolcall tests. Lots of 401s from gateway, shard=12.
jen: CI run https://ci.redwood/run/9876 shows failures and logs attached.
alex: Quick snippet from the agent logs:```
> curl -i https://hosted.redwood/api/v1/stream 
> HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
> WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="missing kid"
> x-request-id: r-abc123
```
alex: Header we send: `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` — kid looked null in a couple of requests.
matt: @matt here, oncall. I'll check auth/key rotation and gateway health.
sam: Can we just rerun shard12 first before full panic? Might be a transient JWKS propagation issue.
priya: Also noticing some tests flake with a schema mismatch for toolcall responses — some tests expect `resolved_tool` and it's not present in a few responses. Possibly a contract tweak on hosted side.
ci-bot: Requested rerun: shard 12 queued (job 9880).
matt: IAM logs show a key rotation event ~2h ago for hosted signing keys. Gateway pulled new JWKS but some caches returned 503s recently. I'm forcing a JWKS refresh on the gateway and checking CDN caches.
jen: FYI platform team rolled a small change earlier today around toolcall payloads — cc @matt did they remove `resolved_tool` intentionally?
matt: Yep, the runtime team changed streaming toolcall to omit `resolved_tool` when the tooling metadata is empty. That would explain schema flakes.
priya: I can open a tiny integ PR to make assertions tolerant (accept either shape) — should be quick. If runtime change is intended, tests should adapt.
alex: PRs are faster than rollbacks in many cases. +1 to tolerant parsing.
sam: Rerun results so far: most tests passed but shard12 still sees 401s after retry. Gateway logs show upstream JWKS returning 503s around the failure times.
matt: I triggered a gateway full-refresh and invalidated JWKS cache at 22:15UTC. Also opened an alert with infra in case propagation is still flaky.
jen: If it keeps failing after another rerun we'll escalate to infra oncall. For now let's merge priya's tolerant parsing and kick a full rerun.
priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/integ-tests/pull/321 — tiny change, unit tests green locally.
alex: :thumbsup: scheduling full rerun in 10m (build 9877).
ci-bot: Full integration rerun started (build 9877). I'll post results when done.
alex: Thanks team. Follow-ups: (1) add a test tag `hosted-schema-tolerant` so we can opt-in for rolling changes, (2) add a small note to the release checklist about JWKS propagation and cache invalidation steps.
jen: I'll add the release checklist note.
matt: Monitoring gateway and IAM; will update if anything else crops up.
ci-bot: Build 9877 completed: preliminary status posting in #eng later.
